tree.label: AAC: correct intended messages before new recognition

children.label: Study endpoint
children.text: Indexed primary sections separate two experienced ALS eye-gaze users—one laboratory participant and one field participant—from nineteen non-AAC touchscreen participants. The field comparison was 27 test phrases against 856 historical utterances; laboratory unscripted speed improvement was nonsignificant. The positive result concerns text entry, not established independent everyday communication.

children.label: Institutional access
children.text: Official access instructions require a DUA signed by the data user and a separate authorized organizational representative. The page reports approximately 999 participants and 1,500 recorded hours. The complete agreement was not assessed here.

children.label: Current service gate
children.text: The current official overview says new users are not accepted and existing users can continue using their recognition models. No enrolled account or individual effectiveness was tested here.

children.label: Existing tool countercase
children.text: The OpenAAC repository README lists validation, PDF preview and conversion utilities. This review did not execute or pin that implementation; its broader message-delivery behavior remains untested.

children.label: What follows and what does not
Conditional contribution
children.text: The plausible software contribution is a narrow preservation or recovery guarantee wanted by an existing receiver. A new recognizer, autonomous message generator or clinical system does not follow from this evidence. Faster input, valid board syntax, exact synthetic output and successful real conversation are different endpoints. A positive small study supports investigation while leaving transfer, independence and durable benefit unresolved.

children.label: Native stop rule
children.text: An available accessible text-and-phrase workflow is the comparator, not a deliberately weak interface. Existing format tools must be inspected before proposing another wrapper. If they already preserve the required message and recovery behavior more simply, custom development stops. No current buyer, paid vacancy, credential shortcut or entitlement to an institutional dataset has been established.

children.label: Receiver and rights gate
children.text: First identify an authorized receiver and one specific missing behavior. Freeze the exact specification, software revision, dependency terms and redistribution scope. Begin with author-created abstract text and state traces; use no participant recordings, personal vocabulary, third-party symbols or downloaded model. Any installation, account, dataset access, external submission or participant work remains separately gated. Do not label a fixture interoperable before the actual schema is pinned.

children.label: Small controlled fixture
children.text: Keep the proposed hundred-case ledger: eighty development cases and twenty held out before adapter tuning. Cover selection, correction or negation, cancellation and undo, import preservation, and interrupted or offline recovery. Predetermine equal coverage and withheld combinations. Unsupported and aborted cases remain visible. The fake receiver must receive nothing until explicit Send; cancellation must not leak a draft, and the emitted string must match the user-accepted state.

children.label: Independent oracle
children.text: Freeze expected strings, state transitions and emission counts independently before implementation. Seed adversarial action orderings and use a fake sink rather than real speech output or an external message channel. Compare the full accepted text, including negation, not merely a semantic similarity score. A model cannot grade its own intended meaning. Preserve the distinction between a displayed draft, a committed message and a recipient actually understanding it.

children.label: Denominators and metrics
children.text: Retain every offered case, including failures, blocked inputs, timeouts and aborted attempts. Report exact output and state, duplicate or wrong emissions, repair attempts, action count and software latency. Keep native and candidate assistance policies comparable. The engineering gate is zero wrong or duplicate emissions on withheld cases, with explicit numerators and denominators. Twenty withheld cases cannot establish a rare-error rate, clinical safety, reduced fatigue or independent everyday communication.

children.label: Effort and progression
children.text: The original first-stage planning envelope is twenty to thirty hours, followed only conditionally by forty to sixty additional hours through ninety days; these are assumptions, not measured effort or a new commitment. Verify available tooling, skills and time first. If a useful defect survives the baseline, prepare a minimal local fixture or patch for later authorized review. Accepted contribution, continuing maintenance and entrusted responsibility are subsequent contingent steps, not promised employment.

children.label: Human endpoint and kill criteria
children.text: Human validation is a separate future arm requiring accessible consent, user-defined goals, appropriate specialist or ethics review, compensation and an independent recipient endpoint. Compare repeated real tasks with each person’s actual access method, recording setup, monitoring, correction, fatigue and recipient comprehension. No recruitment or user study occurred. Stop if no receiver, lawful fixture, independent oracle or useful native gap exists, or if prediction changes intended meaning and adds unpriced review burden.

tree.label: Climate loss: establish one independent useful check

children.label: Native calculation
children.text: The documented engine calculates contract losses from supplied item losses, groupings and policy terms. It points to worked financial examples.

children.label: Calibration limit
children.text: Parameter fitting uses impact observations. The parameter-variability display does not establish sampling uncertainty or the suitability of the chosen cost function.

children.label: Historical procurement
children.text: The issuer sought consulting firms; the stated deadline was 4 September 2025. The leader needed specialised education and five years experience; other experts needed two years after qualification. This record establishes neither a current opening nor an award.

children.label: Separate correctness from truth
children.text: Correct contract arithmetic cannot establish that exposure, hazard or observed-loss inputs are accurate. Fitted impacts cannot serve as their own independent truth.

children.label: What remains unknown
children.text: No native defect, usable claims/exposure data, permitted runtime, independent receiver, paying assignment or predictive validation was established. Public documentation is a discovery route, not an access or employment grant.

children.label: First gates
children.text: FIRST30: 30–45 focused hours, unallocated OWN planning estimates. Fix rights for exact code, dependencies, examples, model and data; pin the implementation and freeze an independent oracle. Use an existing approved CPU environment only. New downloads, installation, spend or accounts require separate authority. No private portfolio or claims access is presumed.

children.label: Owned fictional contract
children.text: Assets are [100,200,300]; event fractions are [0,0.25,0.5,1]. Ground-up loss is value times fraction. A clamps each item loss minus20 to [0,100], then sums; portfolio totals are [0,90,210,280]. B sums first, then clamps total minus60 to [0,200]; totals are [0,90,200,200]. These invented rules are not real policy terms or calibrated hazards.

children.label: Independent denominator
children.text: Derive expectations independently before native output inspection. The twelve item-event ground-up inputs lead to twelve A item outputs and four B portfolio outputs: sixteen financial outputs, scored within0.01 fictional units. Twelve separate corruption cases target declared units, missing/duplicate mappings, grouping/order and stale manifests. No hidden unknown-world truth is recoverable from this fixture.

children.label: Compare and report
children.text: Try the existing implementation and its examples first; do not build a loss engine. Record every offered case, including mismatches, exclusions, errors, ambiguity, abstentions and timeouts. Report maximum absolute error, mutation detection and ordinary-case false rejection. A native rejection is baseline success. Runtime, memory and review steps describe only this tiny fixture, with no industrial-throughput or monetary-benefit conclusion.

children.label: Additional effort
children.text: ADDITIONAL31–90: 60–100 focused hours only if gates pass. Derived TOTAL90: 90–145 hours if both windows are taken. This interprets the author’s word further; it is arithmetic, not measured feasibility, a new budget or an additive commitment to every other project. CPU availability, time and reviewer availability remain unverified.

children.label: Empirical route
children.text: Require separately permitted exposure/outcome data, compatible loss definitions, event identity and information-time vintages. Freeze event/region/time holdouts before tuning; never place rows from one catastrophe on both sides. Compare a simple fixed response and native calibration at matched inputs and effort. Publish event denominators, missing/censored outcomes, valuation/currency/units, held-out bias/error, interval coverage and sensitivity. Small samples cannot validate distant tail return periods; no causal or underwriting conclusion follows.

children.label: Contribution and ownership
children.text: Proceed only when a receiver confirms an uncovered useful case. Prepare the smallest reproducible regression or documentation diff; no submission or outreach is authorised. Record accepted, rejected and pending review outcomes. Reviewed usefulness can precede maintenance; entrusted decisions require domain review and explicit delegation. Payment, employment, leadership and prominence are not established outcomes.

children.label: Stop conditions
children.text: Stop custom work if native tooling satisfies the exact contract, rights/oracle/receiver gates remain absent, or gains depend on leakage, selective reporting, circular labels or renamed functionality. Without permitted empirical outcomes, retain a conformance exercise and its explicit limitations.

tree.label: Static interchange contract
tree.text: Explore a small conformance fixture contribution only after rights, a useful receiver and independent expected outputs are secured. This is proposed and unrun. It has not established a runtime defect, equivalent views, production acceptance, employment or accessible laboratory work.

children.label: Permitted rendering differences
children.text: The standard permits dropping higher harmonics for performance. Negative-scale or non-decomposable transforms have undefined splat rendering. A loading success or a difference outside the defined profile cannot alone establish a conformance defect.

children.label: Coordinate and version contract
children.text: An unspecified coordinate system bypasses conversion. Quantization is configurable; current default format 4 differs from legacy gzip formats. The build can fetch absent compression dependencies automatically. Documentation is not an executed compatibility test.

children.label: Existing conversion and diagnostics
children.text: SplatTransform already offers conversion and diagnostics. Its GLB entry is output-only. It documents preserving model tags where representable, warning in some cases and silently dropping tags in other outputs. No native run was performed.

children.label: Conditional contribution
children.text: A generic converter has a strong existing rival. A useful fixture or diagnostic patch needs a specific uncovered receiver requirement; native adequacy stops custom work. No buyer, vacancy or durable advantage is established.

children.label: First thirty days: FIRST 24 hours
children.text: OWN unallocated planning cap: FIRST 24 focused hours. Review exact software, dependency and fixture rights; pin immutable revisions and a written receiver requirement. Start with self-authored analytic cases and independently calculated expected outputs. Define the supported profile, allowed approximation and unsupported outcomes before any conversion. No install, download, build or renderer run is authorized by this design.

children.label: Independent reference
children.text: Use a separate high-precision evaluator and reviewed closed-form cases. Keep parameter correctness, profile-specific image comparison and artist acceptance separate. The candidate converter or a model judge cannot supply its own ground truth. An out-of-profile case must be identified rather than counted as a successful conversion or an automatic standards failure.

children.label: Native first
children.text: When separately authorized, run existing diagnostics and the simplest supported conversion path first. Compare only shared, declared input capabilities. Keep the original reference and preserve warnings, unsupported cases, dropped fields, crashes and timeouts. Stop if existing flags, tests or a documentation correction satisfy the requirement.

children.label: By ninety days: TOTAL 72 hours
children.text: OWN cumulative cap: TOTAL 72 hours, INCLUDING FIRST 24; at most 48 additional conditional hours. Proceed only for a reproduced, independently observable and useful residual. Reserve fresh transforms, viewpoints, versions and invalid cases before tuning. Small inspectable fixtures come first; larger scene tests need explicit hardware, memory, dependency-network and asset-rights limits.

children.label: All offered work
children.text: Use every offered fixture × format × runtime combination as the denominator, including unsupported results and failures. Record field, orientation and directional-color errors against predeclared tolerances; retained or dropped data; fault-detection misses and false alarms; image differences under a common profile; cold/warm latency, peak memory and setup/review/repair time. No values have been measured.

children.label: Continue and stop gates
children.text: Continue only if independent fresh cases preserve required fidelity and improve a receiver-approved task within explicit limits. Stop without an oracle, lawful fixture, useful receiver or practical resource envelope. A reviewed contribution may lead to maintenance and compatibility responsibility; acceptance, employment, degrees, location and work rights require separate evidence. No outreach or submission occurred.

tree.label: Spatial-data evaluation infrastructure

children.label: Question
children.text: What must a public single-cell reference retain when it is joined to a spatial assay, so that version changes and repeated donors do not silently invalidate the intended held-out test?

children.label: Finding
children.text: Treat structural validity and biological independence as separate acceptance decisions. A small manifest is a possible contribution only after a real receiving workflow confirms that native tools and a plain relational check leave an important gap.

children.label: Identity contract
children.text: The inspected curation schema 7.0.0 requires donor annotation but strongly recommends cross-collection uniqueness. It recommends unknown or pooled for specified uncertain cases. Valid metadata does not certify that distinct text identifiers represent independent people.

children.label: Release clock
children.text: The inspected Census 2.4.0 page is Drafting. Schema and data releases have separate versions; repeated observations retain canonical-instance metadata. This does not establish a current executable release or complete biological deduplication.

children.label: Existing infrastructure
children.text: Native spatial IO,table association and generated fixtures already exist. Code terms do not license participant cohorts or every generated output. The held documentation names BSD-3-Clause code; actual compatible revisions and output terms still require checking.

children.label: Existing donor evaluation
children.text: The published 2024 scTab study selected 22,189,056 human cells from 5,052 donors, 164 labels and 56 tissues, using primary-only 10x-based data from 2023-05-15. Its 70/15/15 allocation is donor-exclusive, with ontology-corrected macro-F1. This is substantial prior evaluation, not a new spatial or study-held-out result.

children.label: Prerequisites
children.text: Use typed records,deterministic joins,hashes,version diffs and elementary evaluation design. Learn basic matrix,feature,annotation and coordinate meanings. Secure an independent setter and a domain reviewer for biological interpretations; neither is recruited here. Diagnose missing skills rather than prescribe an entire curriculum.

children.label: Fixture and permission gate
children.text: Start with invented identifiers and tiny authored matrices, or a documented generator after code/output terms and an approved runtime are established. Pin code,data-build,schema,ontology,feature and matrix meaning. No real-data arm is admitted; paper access is not cohort permission. If these gates fail, retain a limited metadata design.

children.label: First 30-day window
children.text: The source proposes 24–36 focused hours, including a four-hour setup diagnostic. Author 24 cases across version/mapping,identity/reuse,spatial joins and fit/split exposure: eight valid,twelve reject and four independence-unproven. Use 16 exposed cases and eight fresh setter cases only if the setter actually freezes expected outcomes before implementation; otherwise report regression practice.

children.label: Native comparison
children.text: Keep native structural results unchanged. Compare a separate set-based reference before adding one missing guard. Exercise reused donors,unknown/pooled records,local-ID collisions,orphan rows,unmapped tables,changed transforms and fit-on-test exposure. A valid file may remain unsuitable for a particular independence claim; do not relabel every policy exclusion a native-validator defect.

children.label: Continuation
children.text: The proposed 60–90 hours through 90 days is TOTAL,including the first window; it is not additional allocation or promised completion. Continue for one receiver-confirmed migration or regression need. Seek upstream review only after separate permission. A later biological benchmark requires a newly authorised dataset,reviewed labels and suitable holdouts.

children.label: Independent oracle
children.text: A setter defines equivalence groups,mappings,join cardinalities,coordinates,splits and fit exposure before implementation. A second simple relational calculation must not call the guard under test. Different namespaces prevent textual collisions but cannot manufacture distinct biological donors.

children.label: Metrics
children.text: Report every offered case and attempt,including NOT_RUN,errors,exclusions and unproven outcomes. Preserve 8/8 valid accepts and zero PASS among 12 rejects plus 4 unproven as proposed gates,not measurements. Compare exact joins/transforms,setup/retries,elapsed time,memory and total review minutes. The purposive pack does not estimate biological accuracy or population reliability.

children.label: Public routes
children.text: Curation maintainers at Chan Zuckerberg Initiative and SpatialData maintainers at scverse are potential software receivers. Helmholtz Munich affiliation of Felix Fischer and Fabian Theis is publication-time context. Existing repository routes are discovery/contribution references,not permission to contact or evidence of a vacancy,funded placement or current appointment.

children.label: Ownership path
children.text: Permitted reproduction,reviewed useful patch,maintenance through change,and entrusted responsibility are separate steps. Code participation does not establish admission,work rights,clinical competence or paid access. The work can support a portfolio only for guarantees actually demonstrated.

children.label: Falsifier and kill
children.text: Stop custom work if native tools plus the simple manifest meet the contract,or no receiver values the residual. Unresolved identity,rights or expected outputs block stronger claims. No public source can infer complete pretraining independence here; no future hiring or durable human advantage follows.

tree.label: Capability before control
tree.text: Treat this as an unrun capability-and-effect project. Choose one small contract that an independent reviewer considers useful. Do not build another controller merely because a connection succeeds, and do not turn an experimental demonstration into a claim about operator readiness or a future occupation.

children.label: Documented capability
children.text: The producer-held guide read restricts control to Style 2 and demonstrates monitoring. Independent retrieval of that guide failed; its handler was not inspected. The metric reference says Styles 3/4 include all active UEs despite requested conditions; Style 255 lacks available-RIC testing.

children.label: Measured endpoint
children.text: The study tests two software topologies on a 16-core, 64GB host. Reported endpoints are installation, attachment and KPI collection. It does not establish quota-control benefit or operator acceptance; the number of repetitions is unstated.

children.label: Failure report
children.text: Issue 13 is closed. Its author reports decoder abort after connection and suspects a schema mismatch. Cause and current residual remain unconfirmed.

children.label: Separate the outcomes
children.text: Keep setup, accepted request, correct population, applied policy and useful allocation separate. An ACK cannot substitute for independently observed state and allocation under a declared load.

children.label: Native competition and access
children.text: Existing automation already occupies much of setup. A directory, named author or public programme is a contact route, not evidence of a willing buyer, accessible vacancy or lasting advantage.

children.label: First thirty days: define before executing
children.text: Propose 32 focused hours, including the first six for receiver, rights and oracle gates. These are unallocated planning ceilings. Find a potential reviewer through the public project routes, but secure acceptance separately before calling the work useful. No outreach is authorised here. Define one target population, supported action and observable effect. If the contract cannot be bound, keep a source-only limitation analysis and stop the stronger claim.

children.label: Rights and exact version
children.text: Freeze every component commit, protocol and service-model version, report/control style, encoding and configuration before future setup. Review each dependency and fixture licence separately. Public readability is not packet-reuse permission. Use authored cases initially; later traces need sanitisation, permitted use and generation provenance. A code hash records identity, not interoperability. No software installation, network access or hardware operation has occurred.

children.label: Independent fixture
children.text: Prepare twelve exposed contract cases and six fresh cases from a separate setter. Include wrong identities, unsupported requests, invalid policies, mismatched versions and stale measurements without inventing a universal failure response. The reviewer fixes expected capability, membership, permitted failure and effect outcomes before implementation. A second, version-matched reference checks decoding; the candidate application cannot supply its own ground truth. Nothing has been authored or administered yet.

children.label: By ninety days: native first, conditionally
children.text: Only after receiver, permission, exact-version and oracle gates pass, propose an additional 48 focused hours. Begin with unmodified native examples and a static or no-controller comparator. Use one cell and two declared entities in an explicitly approved isolated software fixture. Keep offered traffic and the full configuration fixed in paired comparisons. Require native policy-state evidence and independently specified allocation evidence for the supported action. Connectivity, ping or aggregate throughput alone cannot establish the causal effect.

children.label: Measure every offered case
children.text: Preserve all accepted, rejected, timed-out, decoder-error and unknown-effect outcomes. Count unwanted and missing entities against known membership. Keep unsupported work in the denominator. Report setup, build, review and rollback effort as well as runtime and memory. Proposed acceptance is zero unexpected disagreements on the six fresh cases, with evidence for every disposition. Unknown effects remain unknown and fail any control-effect claim; six agreements cannot estimate deployment failure rates.

children.label: Resource and access stop
children.text: Use an eight-hour setup stop cap within the additional budget. Proposed ceilings are 16GiB memory, 80GB free storage and 24 CPU-hours total; resources are not verified or allocated. Stop on overflow rather than hiding setup costs. No paid spend, spectrum, RF transmission, operator configuration, remote lab account or private trace is authorised. Physical fronthaul, coverage, energy and reliability questions need separate facilities and calibrated measurements.

children.label: Continue only for a real residual
children.text: Continue only when the untouched native path fails an accepted contract and a reviewer can reproduce a worthwhile residual within the declared limits. Reserve an untouched configuration and fresh cases before tuning. If updates already solve the problem, if the action or oracle stays unbound, or if review costs exceed value, stop custom work. A useful regression or candid coverage correction may justify maintenance; employment, domain authority and prominence require separate evidence.

tree.label: Optical interconnect software: prove one useful contract

children.label: Physical result
children.text: The preprint reports six wavelength channels carrying 1.08 Tb/s net over 5 km with offline DSP. Capacity above 10 Tb/s is modelled. Its 10 fJ/bit figure is calculated modulator energy, not whole-system power. Feedback and manual tuning remain; code and data are available on request, not as an established runnable public package.

children.label: Management boundary
children.text: The host contract requires CMIS 5.3 or newer. An MCU mediates optical-engine and laser control; firmware owns internal calibration. The native HAL procedure checks management behavior, not optical link or datapath performance, and assumes a provisioned switch and firmware.

children.label: Keep the tracks separate
children.text: A working metadata checker cannot certify the research transmitter, and the paper does not validate this host stack. Treat physical research and management integration as separate evidence tracks until a permitted version-matched experiment connects them.

children.label: Strongest rival
children.text: The existing suite is the default rival. A new parser or simulator adds little unless a receiver confirms a precise missed case or inadequate diagnosis. Public host documentation does not establish access to lower-level vendor calibration or usable optical hardware.

children.label: First decision
children.text: Prepare a side-by-side acceptance table before implementation. Identify the selected revision, schema, permitted files, expected rejection reasons and an actual review receiver. Inspect existing assertions instead of inferring coverage from test names. If the native path already satisfies the contract, stop the replacement and retain the comparison.

children.label: Access and reference gates
children.text: Use at most twenty optional hours for this first window, with zero assumed cash spend. Confirm the existing environment and personal availability; obtain approval before any installation or artifact acquisition. If exact semantics, component rights or a receiver cannot be established, finish with a contract audit rather than manufacturing a runnable project.

children.label: Owned fixture only
children.text: If those gates pass, create abstract configuration records rather than copying website examples, firmware images or proprietary device models. Preserve a proposed denominator of forty-eight cases: sixteen accepted and thirty-two rejected. An independent reviewer must freeze expected outcomes and withhold a complete mutation family plus a version variant before tuning. Predeclare whether every holdout is inside that denominator.

children.label: Minimal integration
children.text: Use the selected native loader and framework when their permissions and setup are available. Add one small regression or diagnostic improvement, not another control platform. Compare native and candidate behavior on the same offered records. Keep a clear distinction between a mock record, a replayed value and a real device observation.

children.label: Receiver-reviewed contribution
children.text: Allow at most thirty additional optional hours through day ninety. Continue only if a meaningful discrepancy survives the native comparison and an independent receiver wants the artifact. Reproduce it, prepare the smallest local patch and preserve the native runner. Public posting or submission requires later authorization; acceptance and maintenance responsibility are outcomes to observe, not promised jobs.

children.label: Hardware is another gate
children.text: Any later physical correlation needs a separate operator-approved protocol, selected firmware, instruments, permissions and safe procedures. No bus access, flashing, laser operation, hardware purchase or laboratory work is authorized by this plan. Without that access, keep the result about configuration conformance and do not convert it into bandwidth, reliability, thermal or energy evidence.

children.label: Independent oracle
children.text: Report every offered record, false acceptance, false rejection, blocked setup, skip and timeout; do not improve results by dropping failures. The proposed engineering targets are zero invalid records accepted and zero valid records rejected in the declared fixture. They are not rare-failure or safety certification. Publish per-family results, withheld coverage, resource use and the reviewer’s acceptance or rejection.

children.label: Durable responsibility
children.text: Useful skills connect schema/version reasoning, Linux systems, C++ testing, provenance and careful measurement. Progress from a permitted reproduction to a reviewed narrow contribution, then maintenance and explicitly delegated ownership. Stop if circular expected outputs, a toy physical model or inaccessible dependencies are the only support for success.

children.label: Project route
children.text: Meta / FBOSS supplies a public issue route. BSD3 code permission remains separate from firmware and device access.

children.label: Research route
children.text: COPL at Université Laval lists Wei Shi and Leslie Rusch. Publication affiliation does not grant laboratory access or admission.

children.label: Company route
children.text: Ayar Labs is a directory route; current role bodies, degree conditions, remote eligibility and work rights remain unverified.

tree.label: Learning measurement: choose the claim before the model

children.text: Can an assessment score justify a declaration of independent competence, or only forecast performance with the permitted support? First define the receiver decision, the cost of a false declaration, and what evidence could change that decision.

children.label: Finding: distinguish answer, learner and time

children.text: The challenge guide randomly divides answer records for tasks 1/2, but learners for task 4. The latter training set has 4,918 learners; ten queried answers precede prediction of other answers. These are historical mathematics-response tasks, not a delayed withdrawal experiment.

Neither a new answer nor an unseen learner automatically means future independent transfer. Known-learner forecasting, new-learner diagnosis and new-task retention require different tests. These artifacts establish no generative-AI learning benefit or harm.

A 2021 comparison used 4,151 learners, 274,590 responses and five learner-level folds; results emphasized four common skills. DKVMN’s gap over BKT/PFA narrowed after three opportunities, remaining slightly better. Mastery exits and stop-out change who contributes later observations.

Compare fixed item difficulty, a transparent existing tracer, and an ordinary external assessment before adding a custom model. A useful initial diagnosis can matter, but it must improve the chosen decision rather than inherit a stronger learning label. Stop added modeling when the simple route suffices.

The judge preprint studies 596 prompts, nine models and 5,364 completions. Three human scores form each reference. Mean alpha is 0.28 while observed agreement is 81%, with skew noted. Bias estimates condition on reference quality and assume an unbiased human benchmark and shared other preferences.

A low chance-corrected coefficient alone does not invalidate the reference; high agreement alone does not prove correctness. A different model family is not an independent answer key. The demonstrated scoring task is not a learner-outcome validation.

Develop event semantics, missing-data reasoning, calibration, clustered uncertainty and temporal validation. Add rubric design, blinded adjudication, provenance and licence manifests. Learn to distinguish prediction error, a decision loss and a learning effect; keep unknown support and disputed answers visible instead of resolving them through fluent explanations.

Begin with receiver, rights, independent-reference and native-baseline gates. If these fail, retain a synthetic bookkeeping exercise. Plan 30 adversarial cases covering hints, revealed answers, retries, duplicate events, reversed timestamps, missing follow-up, correct alternatives and fluent errors. A separate setter freezes expected outcomes before implementation; exposed keys yield regression practice only.

Preserve every offered event exactly once as scored, ineligible, missing or disputed. Freeze support labels, thresholds and split manifests before held-out results. Keep tutor-generated answers outside the withheld reference. No patient, pupil or employee records, recruitment, installation or paid model call is part of this pass.

Continue the same artifact only with an authorized receiver and lawful independent outcomes. A later protocol could test fresh unaided tasks 7, 28 and 60 days after the last logged assistance, tracking intervening practice and actual elapsed time. Those intervals are planning choices. Historical traces without support enforcement or independent follow-up support a prediction audit only, not a retention estimate.

Report offered, eligible, attempted, completed, excluded, support-unknown, disputed and missing counts by learner, task family and opportunity. Measure calibrated probability error with learner-clustered uncertainty. For every mastery declaration show external pass, fail or missing status; report coverage and uncertainty rather than silently treating missing outcomes as either success or failure.

Measure false acceptance of fluent errors, rejection of correct alternatives, adjudication disagreement and total preparation/review minutes across all attempts. OWN effort assumption: 18–26 conditional hours through day 30 and 40–56 total through day 90, including the first period; a 4–6-hour launch gate is inside those totals. Runtime and resource limits remain unmeasured.

Possible public reading routes include Eedi’s challenge site, Ryan Baker’s publication hub and the judge paper’s declared repository. These identify method contexts, not current funded seats, confirmed receivers or personal eligibility. Current appointments and willingness to review were not independently verified here.

No dataset, item-image or redistribution permission follows from a readable paper. Use wholly authored fixtures until rights and an independent oracle are resolved. Kill the stronger claim if only assisted scores or response prediction improve, follow-up disappears, keys leak, the simple baseline meets the contract, or review burden exceeds receiver value. A reproducible, reviewed correction can support maintenance responsibility; employment or leadership is not guaranteed.

tree.label: Information contract reliability

children.text: Test whether a generated or migrated requirement preserves the owner’s intended object population when a formally allowed setting changes. Keep intended acceptance state as a separate test target. Define the required population in plain language before interpreting a zero-match result.

Required applicability needs a selected object; optional permits none but applies requirements to every selected object; prohibited rejects selected objects and ignores requirements. Optional properties may be absent, but must satisfy datatype/value conditions when present. Targets include IFC2X3, IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2. Invalid models may prevent verification; geometry and external/dynamic checks are outside this scope.

The May 2026 diagnostic uses 166 Japanese/English examples from 83 scenarios, entity/attribute/property facets and ten models. The highest-F1 row has 65.6% facet F1 and 27.7% Content. These are all-example macro agreement and formal-audit endpoints, not end-to-end real-model validation or a current ranking.

The current README excludes applicability occurrence bounds from facet matching while the formal audit checks them. Paper v1 and current main are not proven release-equivalent. The paper states CC BY 4.0; repository documentation separates Apache-2.0 code from CC BY 4.0 data.

Test the complete existing workflow first: requirement audit, model check and explicit bound comparison. It may satisfy the owner’s contract without extra software. A changed-bound example remains a proposed test; preserve successful native results and disputed cases. Require a reproducible discrepancy before treating this as a contribution or product opportunity.

Learn typed document parsing, schema navigation, set membership, missing-versus-empty semantics, unit interpretation and deterministic regression design only where a prerequisite gap is diagnosed. Translate one owner sentence into expected object identities and acceptance states before evaluating generated output. Keep an independent reviewer’s judgement separate from the tool’s own report.

A permitted reproduction can become a reviewed minimal test or documentation correction. Maintain the artifact through a version change before seeking responsibility for the contract. Reviewer acceptance, maintenance access, professional authority and paid work are separate events; this route promises none of them.
